description: Curated synthetic citation-retrieval smoke benchmark. Scores retrieval relevance, not factual correctness or human citation faithfulness; expand with anonymized real course materials before launch.

corpus.text: Calculus derivatives measure instantaneous rates of change and use the limit definition.
Integration computes accumulated quantities and the area under a curve.
Bayes theorem updates prior probability using observed evidence and likelihood.
A sample space contains all possible outcomes of a random experiment.
A balance sheet reports assets liabilities and equity at a point in time.
Cash flow statements classify operating investing and financing cash flows.
Photosynthesis converts light energy into chemical energy using chlorophyll.
Cellular respiration releases energy from glucose to produce ATP.
Newton second law relates net force mass and acceleration.
Momentum equals mass multiplied by velocity and is conserved in isolated systems.
A relational database organizes data into tables with rows and columns.
A SQL join combines related rows from two or more tables.
